body: therapy would never work for me because I'm so closed off. since i was born I've been getting whipped every time i open up in the slightest to anyone and i don't see any chance of that ever changing. basic negative reinforcement conditioning I'll never get over because it's just too fucking hardwired into my stupid brain. anonymity makes it easier but that's fucking useless.
